status: Historical C85 discovery snapshot; source-screen counts below predate later cleanup. Current adjacent-call queue completion is recorded separately.

source_census.scope: Read-only syntax and DWARF inventory. Source definitions are associated by CU/name with concrete compiled owners; conditional duplicate definitions are explicitly marked. Optimized locals include nested and inline scopes. Native names are available vocabulary, not a value/lifetime identity match. Genuine unions and intentional cleanup gotos require review.

next_call_condition_queue.scope: Plain nonvolatile int placeholder locals with unique declarations and no direct address-taking. A direct call assignment is immediately followed by its sole successor if(var ==/!= 0); the assigned value is dead at both condition successors in the conservative statement CFG. Header return spelling is preliminary evidence only; macro expansion, precise function binding/types, nested scope/alias behavior, native evidence and source receipt successors must be reviewed before applying any rewrite. Parser typedef stubs are syntactic, not ABI evidence.

limits: Counts cover the regular C definitions associated with concrete compiled owners by this syntax screen. They do not count every source configuration, macro-generated function, C++ function or pointed-to/aggregate-member union. The all-CU native timer union review is separate. Old naming/remaining-union queues are historical snapshots. No new whole-DLL similarity score is claimed.

simple_guard_screen.status: Read-only exploratory screen. Simple inversion of one forward jump has limited coverage; broader shared dispatchers require a different reconstruction.
